extra_vocab.en: not yet paid, or done without being paid
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於帳務與人資情境：unpaid invoice、unpaid bill 指款項還沒付；unpaid leave、unpaid internship 指沒有薪水。看到前後文談付款就是「未付」，談工作或請假就是「無薪」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: unpaid 是形容詞，可放名詞前（an unpaid bill）或接在 be 動詞後（The bill is unpaid）；若要用動詞說法，是 has not been paid。

example.en: Please settle the unpaid invoice by the end of this month.
example.zh: 請在本月底前結清未付的發票。

example.en: The unpaid balance will be added to your next bill.
example.zh: 未付的餘額會加到您的下一期帳單中。

example.en: She asked for two weeks of unpaid leave in June.
example.zh: 她六月申請了兩週的無薪假。

example.en: The company offers an unpaid internship for college students.
example.zh: 這家公司提供大學生無薪實習的機會。

examples.en: Our records show that your bill is still unpaid.
examples.zh: 我們的紀錄顯示您的帳單仍未付款。

examples.en: The accounting team sent reminders for all unpaid accounts.
examples.zh: 會計部門寄了催繳通知給所有未付款的帳戶。

examples.en: Employees may take unpaid time off with a manager's approval.
examples.zh: 員工經主管同意後可以請無薪假。

confusable.diff: prepaid 是「已經先付過錢的」；unpaid 是「還沒付錢的」，意思相反。

example.en: Customers can buy a prepaid card at the front counter.
example.zh: 顧客可以在櫃檯購買預付卡。

similar.diff: overdue 表示已經超過付款期限；unpaid 只說還沒付，不一定逾期。

example.en: Your overdue payment will be charged an extra late fee.
example.zh: 您逾期的款項將被加收滯納金。

similar.diff: outstanding 較正式，常用於帳務，指尚未結清的金額；unpaid 較通用。

example.en: Please pay the outstanding amount before the end of the week.
example.zh: 請在本週結束前付清未結的金額。

example.en: We have not received your payment for last month yet.
example.zh: 我們還沒收到您上個月的付款。

example.en: You can check your account balance on our website.
example.zh: 您可以在我們的網站上查詢帳戶餘額。

example.en: The electricity bill arrives at the beginning of each month.
example.zh: 電費帳單在每個月初寄達。

example.en: The company pays every employee a salary on the last day.
example.zh: 公司在月底最後一天發薪水給每位員工。

derived.link: unpaid = un-（不）+ paid（付了的），像 unhappy、unable 的 un-
pay + -ment，把「付錢」變成名詞，像 agreement、management
pay + -able，可以或該被付的，像 available、reliable

senses.en: not yet paid, as a bill or an invoice

example.en: We sent a reminder about the unpaid invoice yesterday.
example.zh: 我們昨天已寄出未付發票的催繳通知。

senses.en: done without getting money for the work
senses.distinguish: 出現在人資、實習、請假情境，如 unpaid leave。

example.en: Interns often do unpaid work in exchange for experience.
example.zh: 實習生常以無薪工作換取經驗。
